title: Guide output (JSON agent-skill flavor)
description: The body of `<tool> guide` and GET /guide for the cli-guide-spec convention. See PROTOCOL.md §1. The markdown flavor wraps a string under 'guide' instead.

<tool>.description: A one-line description of what the tool is. The key is the tool's short name.

one_liner.description: The elevator pitch — what the tool does and how, in 1-3 sentences.

model.description: The mental model: key/value pairs explaining the architecture, the split, the moving parts.

loop.description: The canonical end-to-end workflow, one step per element, in order.

concepts.description: Key/value (or nested) definitions of the tool's vocabulary a reader must grasp.

commands.description: Grouped command lists (e.g. {"local": [...], "cloud": [...]}); each entry is a usage string.

do.description: The exact commands to run, in order.

gotchas.description: The things that bite — footguns, surprising defaults, security notes.

version.description: The tool's version at build time, so an agent can detect staleness across updates.
